text:
customer-john: Hey, we're seeing an SSE stream finish without the final finisher frame. Client gets all token chunks but the final `finish_reason` event never arrives and the JSON stream ends mid-object. Repro steps below, this hits production on our platform (eu-west).

customer-john: Repro (minimal):
```
curl -N -H \"Authorization: Bearer SK_...\" \
  -H \"Accept: text/event-stream\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"gpt-j-infer\",\"stream\":true,\"kv_cache_key\":\"convo-42\"}' \
  https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/stream
```
We saw: last SSE events include a partial JSON line ending with `...\"tokens\":[]}` and then connection drops. No `data: {\"finish_reason\":\"stop\"}`. Request header X-Request-Id: abc-req-9012.

alex: Thanks — do you have the raw bytes from the tail of the connection (tcpdump or proxy access) and the exact SDK/client you used? Is there an intermediate proxy (nginx/fastly) doing buffering/keepalive?

customer-john: We run a small nginx ingress + CloudProvider LB fronting the service. Client is Node fetch using `eventsource-parser` to parse lines. I can paste the proxy access logs and the partial tcpdump.

maria: Please paste the proxy logs (request start/end, upstream time) and the complete last 1kB of the tcpdump if possible. Also which model and sequence length? Quantized model?

customer-john: Model: rwd-infer-2.7-q4, max_tokens: 1024, typical prompt len 600-700. Proxy logs: `127.0.0.1 - - [17/Mar/2026:10:12:34 +0000] \"POST /v1/stream HTTP/1.1\" 200 0 \"-\" \"Upstream: 30.120s\"` then 0 bytes after 30s. Tcpdump tail (hex/snippet): `...0a646174613a207b2263686f69636573223a5b7b22646elta...` (truncated) — you can see the last JSON object appears truncated.

ingvar: Quick hypothesis: the runtime emitted the finisher, but an intermediate kept-alive timeout or upstream RST cut the final bytes. Two possibilities: (1) KV cache flush finished concurrently with final logits emission and we saw race that closed the connection before sending the final `data: {...finish_reason...}` frame; (2) nginx/ingress configured `proxy_buffering on` or low `proxy_read_timeout` and dropped the tail.

alex: Can you try a direct curl to the backend bypassing the LB/nginx (port-forward or internal hostname) to see if finisher arrives? Also try `curl --no-buffer` and `--silent` to avoid client buffering.

customer-john: I port-forwarded and retried, the finisher appears reliably when bypassing ingress. So this points to the path. But in one case, even bypassing the LB we saw a resume: the client reconnected with Range resume header and got leftover KV-cache tokens without the closing frame, causing client JSON parse error.

maria: Ok that's helpful. Two actionable mitigations until we fix infra: (A) set nginx `proxy_buffering off; proxy_read_timeout 120s; proxy_send_timeout 120s;` (B) make client resilient to truncated tail by waiting for an idle period + then emitting a synthetic finisher if last event lacked `finish_reason` — log request id.

customer-john: We'll try the nginx changes. Could you also confirm if the server will never send a partial final chunk (like a trailing comma or open brace)? We want to know if client should assume truncation is possible and implement a best-effort fix.

ingvar: Server guarantees: we stream newline-prefixed SSE lines; each `data: ...` contains a complete JSON object per line. The runtime never intentionally leaves an unclosed JSON object — an interrupted connection can leave a partial line. So clients must handle truncated final lines. We're going to add a server-side robustness improvement: include an end-of-stream heartbeat `data: {\"_eos_\":true,\"finish_reason\":\"unknown\"}` before connection close on forced shutdowns.

sre-oncall: Filed INC-2026-0035 to track ingress timeouts truncating SSE tails. Root cause appears to be `proxy_send_timeout` set to 30s in our nginx template. I'm rolling a canary patch to 120s in eu-west and will monitor errors.

support-bot: NOTE: If you need a fast workaround on the client: ignore final incomplete JSON line and treat last successfully parsed object as the end; report the request id to support. See internal KB: /docs/sse-client-resilience. :wrench:

alex: Customer, after the nginx change please retry and paste the raw last 1kB if you hit it again. We'll also add defensive server behavior in the next runtime patch to emit an explicit EOS record during shutdown. Sorry for the trouble.

customer-john: Thanks, applying change now. I'll report back with logs in ~15m. Appreciate the quick triage. :thumbsup:
